name: Lever
description: Lever is an applicant-tracking and recruiting platform built around job Postings, Stages, Opportunities, candidates, applications, interviews, and offers.
agentUseSummary: Authorize Relay's Lever partner integration for one exact Account with only offline_access, postings:read:admin, and stages:read:admin. Agents can list bounded non-confidential Posting summaries and Stage labels. Relay excludes candidate-centric records, confidential postings, content, salary, people, writes, raw APIs, broader scopes, and offset following.

credentialRequirements.name: LEVER_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Lever partner client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Lever-issued Relay partner client ID configured only on Railway.

credentialRequirements.name: LEVER_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Lever partner client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Lever-issued confidential partner secret configured only on Railway.

credentialRequirements.name: LEVER_ACCOUNT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Lever Account ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind the exact Super-Admin-authorized Account before OAuth.

capabilities.label: Read non-confidential Postings
capabilities.description: List bounded safe job Posting summaries.

capabilities.label: Read Stages
capabilities.description: List bounded recruiting Stage labels without candidate membership.

approvalRequired.label: List non-confidential Postings
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five non-confidential Postings from the first page.

approvalRequired.label: List Stages
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five recruiting Stage labels from the first page.

blocked.label: Read candidate data
blocked.description: Candidates, Contacts, Opportunities, Applications, interviews, offers, feedback, notes, forms, files, EEO/diversity, and related records are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read sensitive Lever data
blocked.description: Confidential Postings, users, owners, hiring managers, followers, content/HTML, salary, questions, requisitions, and audit data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change Lever
blocked.description: Posting, candidate, Opportunity, application, interview, offer, webhook, note, file, and every other mutation are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use raw Lever API
blocked.description: API keys, sandbox substitution, arbitrary endpoints, includes, expands, offsets, pagination, raw responses, and broader scopes are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both bounded Lever reads require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Both selected reads run without per-action approval while exact scopes, Account binding, non-confidential filtering, bounds, redaction, refresh, and audit remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two fixed safe Lever list wrappers and attaches refreshed partner OAuth tokens server-side.
Relay mounts two fixed safe Lever list wrappers and attaches refreshed partner OAuth tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Lever partner approval, provider-issued credentials, an exact Railway callback, square logo/description, exact scopes, and authorized staging Account are required.
providerSetup.nextAction: Complete Lever partner registration for the production Data API audience and exact three scopes, configure Railway credentials/callback, then validate Super Admin consent, rotating refresh, Account binding, EU routing, denial, and the two bounded reads.

evidence.supports: Lever documents partner-only organization-wide Super Admin OAuth, registered callbacks/scopes, production audience, one-hour access tokens, rotating refresh tokens, EU routing, and provider-side revocation.
Lever documents form-encoded authorization-code exchange, exact Data API root, list/offset pagination, rate limits, Posting confidentiality filtering, Postings, and Stages.
Lever documents provider-created OAuth applications/credentials and sandbox-versus-production integration setup.
